entries.name: Improved Heroic Strike
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by $/10;s1 Rage.

entries.name: Deflection
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Parry chance by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Rend
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Charge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by $/10;s1.

entries.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
entries.descriptionTemplate: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional $s1 Rage when you change stances.

entries.name: Improved Overpower
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by $s1%.

entries.name: Anger Management
entries.descriptionTemplate: Generates $m2 Rage every $m3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by $s4%.

entries.name: Deep Wounds
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing $m1% of your melee weapon's average damage over $412609d.

entries.name: Spearing Strike
entries.descriptionTemplate: A brutal attack that deals $s2% weapon damage. Deals an additional ${$s2*$s3}% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.

entries.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by $s1%.

entries.name: Impale
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by $s1%.

entries.name: Bloodthrill
entries.descriptionTemplate: Grants your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend a $s1% chance to allow an activation of Overpower.

entries.name: Sweeping Strikes
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your next $n melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

entries.name: Weaponmaster
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

    |CFFFFFFFFAxe/Polearm:|R Increases your
    critical strike chance by $s1%.

    |CFFFFFFFFMace/Staff:|R Your attacks ignore
    $s2% of your target's armor.

    |CFFFFFFFFSword:|R Your successful melee 
    attacks have a $s3% chance to 
    trigger an extra attack on the 
    target.

entries.name: Improved Slam
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by ${$m1/-1000}.2 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by ${$m3/-1000}.1 sec.

entries.name: Improved Hamstring
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Hamstring ability a $m1% chance to immobilize the target for $23694d.

entries.name: Mortal Strike
entries.descriptionTemplate: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus $s2 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by $s1% for $d.

entries.name: Booming Voice
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by $s1% and reduces their Rage cost by $s2%.

entries.name: Cruelty
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by $s1%.

entries.name: Lingering Rage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by ${$s1/1000} sec.

entries.name: Unbridled Wrath
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to generate ${$12964m1/10} additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.

entries.name: Furious Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by $m1%.

entries.name: Piercing Howl
entries.descriptionTemplate: Causes all enemies within $a2 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by $s1% for $d.

entries.name: Blood Craze
entries.descriptionTemplate: Regenerates $m1% of your total Health over $16488d after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than $m2% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

entries.name: Dual Wield Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by $m1% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by $m2%.

entries.name: Raging Blows
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by ${$m2/-10}.

entries.name: Enrage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $h% chance to deal $m1% increased Physical damage for $12880d after being the victim of any damaging attack.

entries.name: Improved Execute
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by $/10;s1.

entries.name: Improved Berserker Rage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate $/10;m1 Rage and has a $m2% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

entries.name: Death Wish
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by $s1% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by $s3%. Lasts $d.

entries.name: Improved Intercept
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Flurry
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your melee attack speed by $m1% for your next $12966n swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

entries.name: Gore Drinker
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next $m1 melee attacks to restore ${$s2}.1% of your maximum Health.

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries.descriptionTemplate: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to $s2% of your Attack Power plus $s1 and increasing your movement speed by $s3% for $d.

entries.name: Improved Bloodrage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by $m1%.

entries.name: Shield Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by $s1% and grants you a $m2% chance to generate ${$1310318m1/10} Rage when you Block.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by $s1%.

entries.name: Anticipation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Defense Skill by $m1.

entries.name: Improved Revenge
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by $m1%.

entries.name: Improved Thunder Clap
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by $/10;s1.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you $12976s1% of your maximum health for $12976d. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

entries.name: Master of Defense
entries.descriptionTemplate: Grants you a $m1% chance to generate ${$23602m1/10} Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.

entries.name: Improved Disarm
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Disarm ability by $/1000;s1 secs.

entries.name: Defiance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional $s1% while a shield is equipped.

entries.name: Improved Sunder Armor
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by $/10;s1.

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Charge ability is now usable while in Defensive Stance.

entries.name: Improved Shield Bash
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Shield Bash ability a $m1% chance to Silence the target for $18498d.

entries.name: Improved Shield Wall
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Shield Wall ability by ${$m1/-60000}.1 min.

entries.name: Concussion Blow
entries.descriptionTemplate: Stuns the target for $d.

entries.name: Focused Rage
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by $/10;s1.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases all damage you deal by $s1% while a shield is equipped.

entries.name: Shield Slam
entries.descriptionTemplate: Slam the target with your shield, causing $s2 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling $s1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
